import json
import os
import sys
from argparse import ArgumentParser

import torch
from torch import nn
from tqdm import tqdm

from src.model import LitModel
from src.utils import (
    get_data_loaders,
    load_model,
    load_state_dict,
    save_model,
    set_seed,
)


def main(args):
    set_seed(args.seed)
    model = load_model(args.checkpoint_path, args.device)
    model.eval()
    data_loaders = get_data_loaders(args.data_path)
    out = {}
    for split in ["train", "valid", "test"]:
        loader = data_loaders[split]
        out[split] = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in tqdm(loader):
                text = batch["text"]
                text_length = batch["text_length"]
                output = model(text, text_length)
                for i, elem in enumerate(output):
                    if isinstance(elem, dict):
                        elem = elem["logits"].detach().cpu().numpy()
                    else:
                        elem = elem.detach().cpu().numpy()
                    out[split].append(elem)
    with open("out.json", "w") as fp:
        json.dump(out, fp, indent=2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint-path", required=True, type=str)
    parser.add_argument("--data-path", required=True, type=str)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda", type=str)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", default=42, type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args)
